metadata.title: Common-Source Assembly for Spherical Minimal Immersions
metadata.abstract: We develop a matching principle for assembling maps from a common manifold into spherical minimal immersions. The equations couple the coefficients to the induced metric and yield examples with nonminimal constituent immersions. We establish existence and uniqueness of matching coefficients under suitable hypotheses and sharp rigidity for complete harmonic assemblies over $\mathbb S^2$. For a Clifford family, the first eigenspace determines the underlying fibration. The principle also produces weighted minimal profiles that generate minimal products in round spheres, with examples formed from finitely many Lawson--Osserman blocks of different degrees over a common Hopf source.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 球面极小浸入的同源匹配构造
analysis.workSummary: 作者把同一源流形上的映射组装为球面极小浸入，匹配系数与诱导度量耦合，允许构件浸入本身非极小；适当假设下有系数存在唯一性，并对S²上完备harmonic assemblies给出尖锐刚性。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造产生加权极小profiles和球面极小乘积，可把同一Hopf源上的不同次数块组合；Clifford族的首特征空间确定底层纤维化。
analysis.limitations: 存在唯一性有未在摘要展开的适当条件；S²完备调和组装刚性不是任意极小浸入的分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。19页PDF完整提取且无短文本页；核对披露关键词上下文及文首文末，未见作者实际使用生成式AI的正向声明。正文Ai为拉回度量等数学记号，不是AI使用。未观察到声明不代表未使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 极小浸入、谱与构造性分析有较强联系。
